merge_queue.note: Reported by .github/workflows/ci.yml jobs typescript, rust-check, and bundle-check on pull_request and merge_group.

promotion_model.build_once: cd-npm-cli.yml job stage and cd-pwa.yml job build upload the npm tree, Pages dist, and release metadata. Later jobs download those artifacts. CLI stage sets CLI_RELEASE_PACK=1 so esbuild omits sourcemaps, and prepare-cli-release deletes *.map files and excludes dist/**/*.map from the publish files list.
promotion_model.main_ci_gate: Before preview jobs, cd-main-ci-gate.mjs requires a successful ci.yml push on main for the same commit with TypeScript, Rust, and Bundle budgets all success.
promotion_model.preview: After main CI passes, Preview publish jobs select environment Preview (no required reviewers) and publish 0.0.0-alpha.N on dist-tag alpha using environment secret NPM_TOKEN via publish-npm-package (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and .npmrc), otherwise OIDC trusted publishing under the same environment. The github-pages deploy runs automatically with no GitHub environment approval.
promotion_model.preview_smoke: Before Production, cd-preview-smoke.mjs polls until SMOKE_REGISTRY_DEADLINE_MS (default 300000) with SMOKE_REGISTRY_POLL_MS (default 10000) between tries. When EXPECTED_VERSION is set it waits for registry propagation via npm view @opensesame-labs/cli@EXPECTED_VERSION version --prefer-online, then requires dist-tag alpha to equal that version, installs @opensesame-labs/cli@alpha, and runs opensesame --version. CLI CD runs that same wait in the Preview publish job (scripts/release/cd-registry-wait.mjs) immediately after publish, with the same deadline and poll defaults, and sets CD_REGISTRY_VERSION_CONFIRMED=1 on preview smoke when the publish job succeeded so smoke skips only the duplicate version wait. Dist-tag equality, the alpha install, and opensesame --version still run. The deadline is not raised. PWA CD sets SMOKE_PUBLISHED_PACKAGE to @opensesame-labs/web-pwa so the same EXPECTED_VERSION wait targets that package before the CLI alpha install, and verifies the live Pages deploy for the commit.
promotion_model.profile_proof: cd-pwa.yml job proof builds the full install profile only, overlapped with job build. Preview publish, Pages deploy, and Production wait for that proof job.
promotion_model.production: When every gate passes, Production downloads the same staged artifacts, verifies live Pages again, rewrites package.json from 0.0.0-alpha.N to 0.0.0-next.N, and publishes that version with npm publish --tag next --provenance using Production secret NPM_TOKEN (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN). When NPM_TOKEN is empty, the same publish uses OIDC trusted publishing. It does not run npm dist-tag add and never publishes latest. The job selects environment Production. No required reviewers on Preview or Production.
promotion_model.failure: Any gate failure skips Production and promotion_failed posts a commit comment via cd-promotion-notify.mjs.
promotion_model.pages_split: github-pages is the live Pages deploy (actions/deploy-pages). It is not the Preview environment. deploy-pages preview:true is not available to the public, so there is no second Pages environment. Do not add required reviewers to github-pages.

github_environment_changes_via_gh.production_required_reviewers: remove rule 70926080; Tyler removed required reviewers (2026-11-02)
github_environment_changes_via_gh.github_pages: keep branch policy main only (rule 62085543). No required reviewers and no wait timer.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.npm_token: Preview npm publish jobs (cd-npm-cli.yml preview, cd-pwa.yml npm_preview) select environment Preview and pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN to publish-npm-package (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN + .npmrc). Production jobs pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN from environment Production the same way for 0.0.0-next.N on tag next with provenance. When NPM_TOKEN is empty, that job uses OIDC trusted publishing under its environment. Production does not run npm dist-tag add.

environments.name: Preview
environments.note: Preview npm publish binds here for NPM_TOKEN. Delete required-reviewer rule 70926078 so a leftover reference cannot wait. See github_environment_changes_via_gh.

secrets.NPM_TOKEN: Publish-scoped npm token for Preview alpha publish. cd-npm-cli.yml job preview and cd-pwa.yml job npm_preview pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN to publish-npm-package.

Publish-scoped npm token for Production 0.0.0-next.N publish on tag next. cd-npm-cli.yml and cd-pwa.yml production jobs pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN to publish-npm-package. When the token is empty, publish uses OIDC trusted publishing. A publish-scoped token cannot change dist-tags (E401); Production does not run npm dist-tag add.

environments.name: github-pages
environments.role: Automatic live Pages deploy of the immutable artifact from cd-pwa.yml job deploy. Not the Preview environment. No second Preview Pages environment: actions/deploy-pages input preview is not public.

protection_rules.note: Do not add required reviewers. Production promotion is gated in workflow jobs, not by environment approval.

environments.name: copilot
environments.note: Existing environment; not referenced by new CD workflows. Reserved for Copilot/automation integrations.

npm_versioning.bump: increment the numeric suffix on 0.0.0-alpha.N from the npm registry

dist_tags.production_promotion: next on 0.0.0-next.N (same numeric suffix), NPM_TOKEN or OIDC publish, never latest

dist_tags.next: Production publish of 0.0.0-next.N with NPM_TOKEN, or OIDC when the token is empty

npm_packages.name: @opensesame-labs/web-pwa

dist_tags.next: cd-pwa.yml Production publish of 0.0.0-next.N with NPM_TOKEN, or OIDC when the token is empty

npm_packages.payload: Built static dist (HTML, JS, WASM, manifest, service worker) from the same production Pages build uploaded to GitHub Pages

npm_trusted_publishing.oidc_fallback: Preview and Production pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN into publish-npm-package when set (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN + .npmrc, npm publish --provenance). When the token is empty, the action uses id-token: write and OIDC trusted publishing under that environment. Production publishes 0.0.0-next.N on next and does not run npm dist-tag add or move latest.
npm_trusted_publishing.recommended: Configure npm trusted publishers for each @opensesame-labs package (see publishers[]). Preview rows set environment to Preview. Production rows set environment to Production. Allow npm publish.
npm_trusted_publishing.first_publish: Trusted publishing supports the first npm publish once the publisher row exists. Until then, configure NPM_TOKEN on environments Preview and Production. An empty Production token still attempts OIDC under environment Production.
